detail: Base determination: Chen2020 (task text names no electrode system -> anchor table default, recorded). Lever set for rate: positive particle radius (r^2/D scaling, allowed lever), electrolyte transport sigma/D/t+ (formulation), electrode thickness (ED-rate Pareto).
